title: Melatonin's share of unsupervised pediatric medication ED visits, 2019-2022

source.name: Emergency Department Visits for Unsupervised Pediatric Melatonin Ingestion -- United States, 2019-2022 (MMWR)
source.publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: Among emergency department visits for infants and young children who ingested medication without supervision (2019-2022), melatonin alone accounted for roughly 11,000 visits, about 7% of the total.
